title: CRE Insurance Compliance Monitoring for Loan Portfolios | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Monitor required insurance coverage across commercial real estate loan portfolios — lapse alerts, certificate tracking, and servicing-integrated compliance.
h1: CRE insurance compliance monitoring inside servicing
lede: Expired certificates are a quiet portfolio risk. When coverage tracking lives in broker portals and inboxes, lapses surface too late — at claim time or covenant review.

sections.heading: The compliance gap
paragraphs: Servicing teams can remittance-perfect a book and still miss that a policy lapsed last month. Insurance oversight belongs in the same operating layer as payments and delinquency — not a side spreadsheet.

sections.heading: How we structure monitoring
paragraphs: Required coverage inventory per asset, ongoing tracking of certificates, automated alerts when a policy approaches lapse or falls out of compliance, and escalation paths before the collateral is unprotected.
bullets: Reporting suitable for credit and risk committees

sections.heading: Built for institutional CRE
paragraphs: Designed for commercial real estate and business/commercial loan portfolios — not consumer home insurance products.

faqs.q: Is insurance monitoring separate from servicing?
faqs.a: No. We treat corporate insurance compliance as part of the servicing operating matrix so gaps are visible alongside payment and delinquency status.
Escalation is configured with your credit/ops team during onboarding so the right owners are notified before coverage fails.

ctaHeading: See insurance monitoring on a live walkthrough
ctaBody: We'll show how coverage status appears alongside the rest of the servicing stack.
